ja: あのとき君が引っ越しを手伝ってくれていなかったら、僕は今でも段ボールに囲まれて暮らしていただろうね。
en: If you hadn't helped me move back then, I'd still be living surrounded by cardboard boxes.
alternatives: If you hadn't helped me with the move back then, I'd still be surrounded by cardboard boxes.
Without your help with the move back then, I'd still be living among cardboard boxes.
point: 過去の条件は had 過去分詞、今の結果は would be -ing

ja: 彼女は今週もう3回も僕のシフトを代わってくれたから、今回は僕が引き受けるべきだね。
en: She's already covered my shift three times this week, so I should take this one.
alternatives: She's already taken my shift three times this week, so I should do this one.
Since she's covered for me three times this week already, I ought to take this one.
point: 「今週もう3回」は現在完了、already の位置に注意

ja: もっと早く言ってくれていたら、引っ越しを喜んで手伝ったのに。
en: If you had told me earlier, I would have been happy to help you move.
alternatives: If you'd let me know sooner, I would've gladly helped you move.
If you'd told me sooner, I'd have been happy to help you move.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had 過去分詞、主節は would have 過去分詞

ja: 来週末の引っ越し、手伝ってもらえないかな？お昼はもちろんおごるから。
en: Could you help me out with the move next weekend? I'll buy you lunch, of course.
alternatives: Would you be able to help me out with the move next weekend? Lunch is on me, of course.
Could you give me a hand with the move next weekend? I'll treat you to lunch, of course.
point: 「手伝う」は help me out with 〜 の句動詞で自然に

ja: 彼女は週末に車を貸してくれただけでなく、鍵を渡す前にガソリンまで満タンにしてくれたんです。
en: Not only did she lend me her car for the weekend, but she also filled up the tank before handing me the keys.
alternatives: She not only lent me her car for the weekend but also filled up the tank before she handed me the keys.
Not only did she let me borrow her car for the weekend, she even filled the tank before giving me the keys.
point: Not only で始めたら did she lend と語順を倒置する

ja: 駅に着いたら電話するから、迎えに来てもらえる？
en: I'll call you when I get to the station. Could you come pick me up?
alternatives: I'll give you a call when I get to the station. Can you come get me?
Could you come pick me up? I'll call you once I get to the station.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形で get to とする

ja: 私が引っかかったのは、頼まれたこと自体じゃなくて、まるで私に借りでもあるかのような彼の頼み方だったんだ。
en: What bothered me wasn't the favor itself, but the way he asked, as if I owed him one.
alternatives: It wasn't the favor itself that bothered me, but the way he asked, as if I owed him something.
What got to me wasn't the favor itself but how he asked, like I owed him one.
point: What bothered me wasn't A, but B で「引っかかったのは A ではなく B」を強調する

ja: 忙しいなら無理に引き受けなくていいからね。気を遣わないで。
en: If you're busy, you don't have to take it on. Don't feel obligated.
alternatives: Don't worry about it if you're busy. You don't have to say yes.
If you're too busy, you don't need to do it. Don't feel pressured.
point: 「しなくていい」は don't have to、mustn't は禁止になる
